verdict.rationale: Better Stack is an observability SaaS platform, not an agent, so the official MCP server axis applies. Multiple first-party pages claim a "top tier MCP server" that exposes logs, metrics, traces, web events and errors to LLM workflows. They also name Claude Code and Claude Desktop as clients, including chart rendering in Claude Desktop. The evidence is marketing-level only, so the depth of the server is unproven. Missing for 10: setup/connection and authentication docs for the MCP server, a list of exposed tools or operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
